mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently 71 degrees and foggy by the Verona Public Library. If you are awake early, the International Space Station will be visible at 4:24 AM, rising over Cross Plains and traveling toward Oregon and Fitchburg until it is almost directly overhead.

Regarding city news, utility work for the Aldi development has wrapped up its first phase, with phase two road construction and traffic shifts beginning the week of September 7th. Additionally, the Military Ridge State Trail paving project continues, with a trail closure scheduled between Lincoln and South Franklin Street from mid-September through mid-November.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today you can enjoy the Dane County Farmers Market or live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking forward, Yoga at Insight Wellness is on September 7th, while next week brings trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, along with the downtown Farmers Market on September 9th.

The Verona Police Department has reported that on September 4th, they arrested 34-year-old Halla Nelson of Madison following an investigation into an inappropriate relationship that occurred on Sunday, August 30th.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. The store is currently closed, but it opens today at 10:00 AM.
